# The DNS callback reads Fallback outside the inspected Thunderbird schema

The inspected Thunderbird DNSOverHTTPS schema declares Enabled, ProviderURL, ExcludedDomains and Locked, but no Fallback. Its callback nevertheless checks Fallback === false inside the presence check for Enabled and assigns mode3 without a separate Enabled-true guard. These exact source windows establish a static callback/schema boundary. They do not establish whether the platform validator accepts, strips or rejects that property, or how a live DNS request behaves.

Scope: Enterprise policies.
